name: Record sharing access matrix
summary: When an approved access policy has to reach the CRM, the system owner lays the current sharing setup beside the proposed one, by record type and by role, internal and external. Every change is a question for its owner; inherited and platform-fixed settings are marked unknown.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own published map of a sharing change in a CRM: who starts it, what the current setup is compared with, who confirms the intended access, who implements it and who owns exceptions.
